title: Same-condition three-arm comparison: does the Pi fork change pass rate?
hypothesis: Every rotom benchmark score so far ran the dev-agent arm on upstream public Pi 1.4.0 through the ROTOM_PI shim, so it never measured the Pi fork a release actually ships. Running native-pi, dev-agent and rotom-fork on the same task set, model and thinking level separates the extension/policy effect from the fork effect, and shows whether either is distinguishable from noise at 62 tasks.
measurement: FrontierHarness Eval 62 tasks pinned at sha256:9236400f (same digest as the earlier runs), 3 arms x 4 attempts = 744 planned trials, custom/bailian/deepseek-v4.1-flash at thinking max, Runta sandbox at 4 vCPU / 8192 MiB / 32768 MiB, fixed concurrency. Smoke first: 3 fast tasks x 3 arms, then extrapolate cost and wall clock before the full run.
result: 预注册规则未改；实际只跑第一轮（62 x 3 = 186 次），第二轮及以后未跑，所以 k/4 主指标、pass@4、pass^4 都算不出来。条件与预注册的差异：沙箱从 Runta 换成 GCP e2-standard-8 单机 Docker（容器 2 vCPU / 4096 MiB、并发 4），因为 Runta 返回 balance_exhausted；模型网关对云上 IP 直接超时，API 流量走操作机到 VM 的反向 SSH 隧道，整轮依赖那条链路在线。结果（有分 / 通过）：native-pi 60 / 37 = 61.7%，dev-agent 61 / 30 = 49.2%，rotom-fork 58 / 36 = 62.1%；模型花费 $2.56 / $2.41 / $2.29。逐题配对 bootstrap 95% 区间：rotom-fork - native-pi +0.0pp [-8.8, +8.8]（57 对，3 赢 3 输）；dev-agent - native-pi -11.7pp [-21.7, -1.7]（60 对，2 赢 9 输）；rotom-fork - dev-agent +10.3pp [+0.0, +20.7]（58 对，8 赢 2 输）。限流事故：18:53 UTC 起网关对 deepseek-v4.1-flash 返回 429 Allocated quota exceeded，rotom-fork 62 次里 28 次、dev-agent 2 次命中；补跑后仍有 3 题 fork 限流，记为 unknown。未修正的读数会给出 fork 低 28.3pp 的假结论。结论：一轮内看不到 Pi fork 改变通过率（区间含 0、宽约 ±9pp）；扩展加策略叠加在公开 Pi 上低 11.7pp，区间不含 0，代价是 agent 超时 10 对 5。外推限制：单轮、单模型、62 题，沙箱不是 Runta，rotom-fork - dev-agent 区间下界压在 0 上。逐题记录见 docs/agent/frontier-harness-eval-three-arm-20261122.csv。
